name: Text to Blog AI Publisher (With Tavily Research)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a professional blog writer. Transform the given text and research into a well-structured, engaging blog post with: 1) An attention-grabbing introduction 2) Well-organized body paragraphs with subheadings 3) Key takeaways or insights 4) A compelling conclusion 5) SEO-friendly content. Incorporate the research findings naturally. Format the output in HTML with proper tags (h2, h3, p, ul, li, strong, em).' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.enhancedContent + '\n\nPlease transform this into a complete, well-researched blog post. Cite the research naturally in the content.' }], temperature: 0.7, max_tokens: 2500 }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: 'Blog post created successfully with research', data: { title: $('Format Blog').item.json.title, wordCount: $('Format Blog').item.json.wordCount, researchSummary: $('Format Blog').item.json.researchSummary, sourcesCount: JSON.parse($('Format Blog').item.json.sources).length, wordpressPostId: $json.id, wordpressLink: $json.link } }) }}
